idea-plugin.name: SageMath
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Syntax highlighting for .sage, .sagews, .spyx files (Python superset plus Sage preparser constructs: R.<x> generators, ^ as power, Sage REPL magics).
  • Brace matching and line/block comment support.
  • Live templates for common Sage constructs (def, class, polynomial ring, number field, finite field, elliptic curve, plot, …).
  • Color settings page.
  • Run configurations for Sage scripts, with native and WSL execution, --python and --preparse modes.
  • Global SageMath settings under Settings → Tools → SageMath.
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for the SageMath computer algebra system in IntelliJ-based IDEs.
  • Syntax highlighting for .sage, .sagews and .spyx files
  • Brace matching and line/triple-quoted comment support
  • Live templates for common Sage constructs (polynomial ring, number field, elliptic curve, plot, …)
  • Run configurations for Sage scripts, with native and WSL execution
  • Thousands of recognised Sage built-ins and category names — regenerable from your local Sage install

Disclaimer: This is an unofficial, community-maintained plugin and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or developed by the SageMath project. SageMath is a trademark of its respective owners.
